outcome: Implement deterministic qpfid0 identity-ID derivation from the landed Step A identity artifact using existing QPF canonicalization and SHA-256, with pinned golden vectors.
definitionOfDone: qpfid0 derivation uses the existing QPF canonicalize/canonicalizeToBytes implementation.
identity_id and created_at are the only excluded fields from the stable identity projection.
golden vector is independently pinned and passes.
reordering object members does not change the derived ID.
substantive identity changes change the derived ID.
No Genesis, verifier, API, deployment, wallet, mint, or economic state changes are made.
